comment: The difference between a snapshot and the base two devices share (docs/synchronisation.md §31): `cases` and `draws` give a base, a snapshot, the difference that must come out of the two (`delta`: the entities, tombstones, order and orderStamps that are new or changed, in the form of a snapshot, then `removedEntities` and `removedTombstones` as [{kind, id}] and `removedLists` as keys, all three sorted by UTF-16 order) and the SHA-256 of the canonical form of the snapshot, which the base plus the difference must rebuild; `failures` are differences a base does not take (the rebuild answers the reason in `problem`). It is a file snapshot: src/shared/sync-delta.test.ts rewrites it with `pnpm exec vitest run src/shared/sync-delta.test.ts -u` and refuses a difference otherwise, and LuciumKit (SyncDeltaTests) plays it against SyncDelta.swift: the same difference, the same rebuild, the same refusals.

cases.name: an entity whose field changed goes whole, with its marks
a field that only changed its mark is a change
an entity added, and one removed
the last entity of a kind removed, and a kind added
a tombstone added, one changed, one purged
a list reordered goes whole with its mark; a list with the same ids and a new mark goes too
a list that is gone is removed with its mark, a new one is written
a kind or a list this version does not know is carried like the others: unchanged, it is not in the difference
the removals are sorted by UTF-16 order (a character outside the basic plane is before a letter above it)

failures.name: a removed entity that the base does not hold
failures.problem: a removed entity that the base does not hold

failures.name: an entity both written and removed
failures.problem: an entity both written and removed

failures.name: a removed tombstone that the base does not hold
failures.problem: a removed tombstone that the base does not hold

failures.name: a tombstone both written and removed
failures.problem: a tombstone both written and removed

failures.name: a removed list that the base does not hold
failures.problem: a removed list that the base does not hold

failures.name: a list both written and removed
failures.problem: a list both written and removed
